New York: A Graff ring priced to finish second at Christie's outsold the sale's own headliner, closing at $256,000.

Christie's 266-lot Jewels Online sale ran 6-15 October, totaling $9.32 million. An 8.17-carat flawless diamond, estimated up to $350,000, sold for $243,200 — short of its floor. The Graff, estimated at just $180,000-280,000, closed at $256,000, the sale's real top lot.

Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.
